about_the_game:
A MEDIEVAL JOURNEY WITH A V8 ROAR

Lead your iron steed into sprawling battlefields and deadly arenas bristling with traps and obstacles. Pick your class, craft your own war machine and prove your mastery on the field.

Immerse yourself in a rich Medievalpunk world where high‑fantasy lore meets roaring engines and arcane Aether magic.

METAL ON METAL

In War of Wheels, carnage unfolds across two thrilling modes:

Gladiatorial Arena: Enter trap‑filled coliseums for one‑on‑one jousts, where unpredictable magic and environmental hazards keep every match fresh.

Field Battle: Roam the open world, ambush enemy factions, and engage in epic team skirmishes. Will be released during Early Access.

FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE WAR MACHINES

Select from five powerful car classes—Knight, Ranger, Assassin, Barbarian, and an exclusive Early Access class Artificer—and outfit your vehicle with unique weapons and abilities. Unlock armor plates, spike bumpers, and Aether‑infused upgrades to create a combat rig that’s as lethal as it is stylish.

KEY FEATURES

  • Fantasy Classes: 5 distinct car classes blending RPG archetypes with vehicular combat—each with bespoke weapons and skills.

  • Diverse Biomes: Battle across 4 unique environments, from fortified cities to frozen tundras.

  • Deep Customization: Unlimited combinations of skins, decals, weapons, and gadgets to perfect your war rig.

  • Destructible Arenas: Wreak havoc in dynamic coliseums filled with traps and breakable scenery.

  • Faction Politics: Align with one of 4 powerful guilds, each with its own goals and storyline.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Most modern 64bit Linux distributions
  • Processor: Dual-Core 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 660 with latest proprietary drivers (not older than 6 months) / similar AMD with latest proprietary drivers (not older than 6 months; the minimum supported resolution for the game is 720p) with Vulkan support.
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 660 with latest proprietary drivers (not older than 6 months) / similar AMD with latest proprietary drivers (not older than 6 months; the minimum supported resolution for the game is 720p) with Vulkan support.
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
